description: Gujarat forms an AI Task Force led by top experts to drive AI adoption, capacity building, and socio-economic development, with support from Microsoft at GIFT City
body_lead: Formation of an A.I. Taskforce To Position Gujarat as a Leader in Technology-driven Governance and Socio-Economic Development - CM Shri Bhupendra Patel’s Announcement Mon, 16 Dec, 2024 Immediate Implementation of CM Shri Bhupendra Patel’s Announcement at Somnath Chintan Shibir Formation of an A.I. Taskforce To Position Gujarat as a Leader in Technology-driven Governance and Socio-Economic Development - The state government’s MoU with Microsoft to set up an AI Centre of Excellence at GIFT City is poised to drive AI integration across multiple sectors.
